acip: ,CES GNAS SKABS SU LAS KYI SGRIB PA KUN 'DAG PA DANG, LAM 'DI LA BSAM GTAN BYAS PA TZAM DANG, GLEGS BAM BKLAG PA DANG, KHA TON DU BYAS PA DANG RGYUD KYI GLEGS BAM BRIS PAS KYANG MTHO RIS KYI DPAL SPYI DANG, KHYAD PAR BA 'KHOR LOS SGYUR RGYAL 'THOB PAR 'GYUR BAR GSUNGS LA,
wylie: ces gnas skabs su las kyi sgrib pa kun 'dag pa dang, lam 'di la bsam gtan byas pa tsam dang, glegs bam bklag pa dang, kha ton du byas pa dang rgyud kyi glegs bam bris pas kyang mtho ris kyi dpal spyi dang, khyad par ba 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'thob par 'gyur bar gsungs la
english: These lines describe how, in the short run, all of the obstacles caused by one's past deeds are purified.  And anyone who does no more than practice meditative concentration on this path--or who reads the volumes that explain it, or recites them, or writes out books of the secret teaching--by such activity gains in general a glorious life in one of the higher births.  To be more specific, they win a rebirth as one of the Wheel Empowered Emperors of the World.
